description: Upgrades the #4501 multi-winding-sum divergence from scope-(a) (leading truncation) to scope-(b) (structural). Thurston's Dehn-surgery bound gives 0<Re𝔙₄₁(u_{m,ℓ})≤Vol(4₁) for every filling slope, with Re𝔙→Vol(4₁) as |(m,ℓ)|→∞. So every even-channel bridge term e^{−Re𝔙/ℏ_q} ≥ e^{−Vol(4₁)/ℏ_q}=ε₀>0 and → ε₀ (≠0): the term test fails and the multi-winding SUM diverges for the EXACT potential, not just the quadratic truncation. Structural exclusion (cited invariant: Thurston Dehn-surgery volume bound) of the multi-winding even-channel SUM as the c₃ magnitude source. Surviving route: a single geometric structure u(q₀), not a lattice sum. No fit; nothing wired; no instance.
